description: Naves, Juan at Universidade da Coruña publishes image-based surface-velocity observations from a retention pond through Co-UDlabs. A camera system recorded preliminary filling and emptying experiments in an Aalborg University monitored pond. Raw/processed images and velocity maps were generated to assess LSPIV feasibility and usefulness for calibrating CFD models of facility operation. Coverage is the Aalborg retention-pond installation in Denmark; experiment dates and frame intervals are not specified. Zenodo provides experiment ZIP archives and a PDF data report with free access under CC BY 4.0. These observations support the source-defined drainage measurement, physical-model or simulation activity. Related Co-UDlabs experiments describe other assets and test conditions; they are not assumed to be independent or interchangeable measurements. A limitation is surface imagery alone does not establish the complete three-dimensional flow field and the source describes preliminary tests. Only native metadata and file descriptors were read; no data values, archive, code or report body was obtained.
